fullDescription: A premium dark-themed mobile streaming dashboard featuring a sophisticated color palette of deep charcoal, vibrant orange-red gradients, and electric blue. The design utilizes a 'Plus Jakarta Sans' typographic scale, subtle noise textures for depth, and high-gloss UI components with glassmorphism elements. Suitable for media libraries, fintech portfolios, or e-commerce marketplaces requiring a high-end, immersive aesthetic.
prompt:
## Resumo
A modern, mobile-first streaming interface with a dark #0c0a09 background, featuring a two-column movie grid, interactive category tabs with vibrant orange-to-red gradients, and a high-contrast blue search interface. The UI is defined by rounded corners (16px-24px), glassmorphism effects, and a subtle SVG noise overlay for a tactile feel.

## Estilo Visual
Apply a base theme of #0c0a09 with a subtle SVG noise filter overlay at 0.03 opacity. Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' as the primary font family. Colors: Primary Gradient (linear-gradient(135deg, #f97316 0%, #dc2626 100%)), Action Blue (#2563eb), Secondary Gray (#1c1917), Text Primary (White), Text Secondary (#64748b). Borders should be thin (1px) with low opacity white (5% to 10%). Cards must use a soft drop shadow: `0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)`. Interactive elements should have a scale transition (scale-95) on active states. Corner radii: Large buttons/Tabs (24px), Cards/Search (16px).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header and Navigation
Position the header with 56px (pt-14) top padding. Implement a dual-tab navigation system at the top where tabs are 48px height with 24px border radius. The active tab uses the orange-red gradient; the inactive tab uses a dark #1c1917 background with a subtle border.

### Search Interface
Below the tabs, place a search bar row (20px top margin). The search input is a container with 48px height, #1c1917 background, 12px border radius, and a 1px white/10 border. Include a search icon (slate-500) and a primary blue (#2563eb) 'Search' button with 12px border radius and 24px horizontal padding.

### Content Grid
The main area is an overflow-y-auto container with a 2-column CSS grid. Use a 16px (gap-4) spacing between cards. The grid should have 16px horizontal padding and a 24px bottom margin to prevent clipping.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Interactive Movie Card — A 3:4 aspect ratio media card with nested glassmorphism controls.
Create a vertical stack with a 3:4 aspect ratio container. Container has 16px border-radius, overflow-hidden, and a 1px white/5 border. Inside, include a full-bleed cover image. Top-right corner features a 36x36px circular button with `backdrop-blur-md` and `bg-black/40`. Below the image, add a text group: Title (font-weight: 600, truncate) and Year (font-size: 12px, color: #64748b).

### Gradient Pill Tab — A high-visibility call-to-action tab.
Design a 48px height pill tab using a 135-degree linear gradient from #f97316 to #dc2626. Apply a soft shadow colored after the gradient (#991b1b/20) for a glow effect. Text should be white, 18px size, and 600 weight.
